profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft | Copilot
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
MCX Agentic Engineering
M365 Copilot Chat 
iOS One Copilot Mobile
iOS Outlook Mobile

positions.title: Student Web Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated in a team of three responsible for developing and maintaining the applications and services of over 50 organizations under the Division of Student Affairs department for the University of Florida. 
- Developed modern UI frameworks and services that aided in improving user experience and web performance throughout 80+ University of Florida websites.

positions.title: Career Prep Fellow
positions.description:
- Selected as one of 400 to be a part of a nationally recognized 18-month professional development program for high-achieving diverse talent.
- Engage in career development training, which includes participating in business case studies, completing monthly assignments, and collaborating with other minority future industry leaders. 
- Participate in four professional conferences hosted by industry leaders, such as Deloitte, Goldman Sachs, and Target.

positions.title: HSF STEM Scholar
positions.description: Selected out of a highly competitive pool of qualified students to attend the 2019 HSF STEM Summit, an annual conference that gives high achieving HSF STEM Scholars an inside track to career success in STEM fields, through a combination of mentoring, professional insights, and career guidance

positions.title: Data Scientist Shadow
positions.description:
- Selected over among 200 applicants to work in a semester-long practical work project with InfoTech, a software company that focuses on applying IT to facilitate government construction and contracting.  
- Utilized Python and Pandas’ data analysis libraries to create data regression models to predict InfoTech’s highest/lowest areas of capitalization with 25% more accuracy than the historical average.

educations.schoolName: Ronald W. Reagan/Doral Senior High School

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Director of SHPEWorks: a series of crash courses intended to increase technical awareness, including introductory coding workshops to Java and Python, as well as nontechnical events, such as entrepreneurship workshops.
- Responsible for organizing and marketing the annual SHPE hackathon, intended to attract and encourage student participation across all fields of engineering.
